Frequently Asked Questions

What can I bring into chat?+

Start with a prompt, a file, screenshots, references, or rough notes. You can also speak your idea. Runable uses that context to help you move forward.

Is chat only for answering questions?+

No. Ask Runable to research a topic, draft content, work with files, or build a website. The conversation is where the work starts.

Can I change what Runable makes?+

Yes. Review the result and ask for changes in the same conversation. Refine the details until the result fits what you need.

Can I export my work?+

You can review and export supported outputs from their preview. The available download formats depend on what you’ve created.

Can I pick up where I left off?+

Yes. Return to your conversation to continue refining your work with its existing context.
